# assistant-text

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Renders assistant text events in the JSONL viewer, with optional markdown rendering; a text block the agent is still writing (a jsonl-viewer streaming stand-in) is revealed at a steady pace with a soft fading edge rather than in the bursts it arrives in. Exports AgentProse — the agent's words (markdown with active-data, steadily revealed while still written) as every surface shows them: the transcript row and an agent thread's answer.
- Web:
  - Contributes:
    - `JsonlViewer.EventRenderer` "assistant-text" → `AssistantTextRow`
    - `JsonlRowActions.Item` "markdown-toggle" → `MarkdownToggleAction`
    - `JsonlRowActions.Item` "copy-assistant-text" → `CopyAssistantTextAction`
  - Uses:
    - `active-data.ActiveDataMarkdown`
    - `conversations/conversation-view.conversationPane`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer.JsonlViewer`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer.useRowMarkdown`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer.useStreamingRow`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/row-actions.CopyTextAction`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/row-actions.EventRowActions`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/row-actions.JsonlRowActions`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/steady-reveal.useSteadyReveal`
    - `primitives/css/text.Text`
    - `primitives/icon-button.IconButton`
    - `primitives/select-scope.ContentScope`
  - Exports (types): `AgentProseProps`
  - Exports (values): `AgentProse`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Uses tokens:
    - `ui/tokens/density --space-md`
    - `ui/tokens/density --space-sm`
  - Imported by: `conversations/agent-thread`
